SMEs should consider the use of ASPs to assist in the transformation of existing business processes and to facilitate e-business.
ASPs are a viable option for SMEs to outsource e-business processes, especially in the short-term.

ASPs are a viable and cost-effective solution for the majority of SMEs, especially those that are unable to invest in their own infrastructure and/or do not have the in-house expertise to manage their own systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SMEs should consider ASPs as a strategic option to enhance their business processes and as a means for achieving their e-business goals.
ASPs can provide SMEs with a cost-effective means to deploy web-based technologies and e-business processes.
